title: Carasent AB (publ) – Year-end report January–December 2024
content:
Carasent AB (publ) – Year-end Report January–December 2024

Q4 2024 Performance:
- Net sales reached 78.7 MSEK, up 22% year-over-year from 64.4 MSEK
- Organic growth contributed 15%, with acquisitions adding 9%
- Recurring revenues totaled 70.0 MSEK (58.5 MSEK prior year)
- Adjusted EBITDA margin stood at 15% versus 10% previously
- Operating cash flow improved to 16.3 MSEK from 4.6 MSEK

Full Year 2024 Results:
- Annual net sales climbed to 275.3 MSEK, representing 12% growth
- Recurring revenues reached 252.0 MSEK with organic expansion of 16%
- Operating loss (EBIT) was -54.5 MSEK compared to -77.9 MSEK in 2023
- Annual operating cash flow improved substantially to 37.7 MSEK from -4.0 MSEK

Earnings Per Share: -0.58 SEK for the full year
